name: Carol Leung
text: Visited the restaurant on November 10. We arrived after the lunch hour rush and were the only table. A stone-faced server took our order, bread arrived, and we asked for two plates. She then disappeared to work on something else. My husband and I were quite pissed with the sloppiness and asked to see the manager / a supervisor. Fay (we hope we’ve got your name spelt correctly) came to us and we explained our concern. This gentleman immediately corrected the situation and we received what we hope was the usual hospitality that they treat their guests with.  The food was very good - we ordered soup, burger, hummus and arancini. The hummus was the best we tasted in Cairo. Thank you Fay for making our dining experience a joy.

text:
⭐ 1 star — Absolutely horrible experience at the Sky Square Mall branch.

The hygiene standards here were extremely concerning. While my sandwich was being prepared, I saw a worker playing with/touching her nose and then continuing to prepare my food. I also noticed the restaurant was filled with flies, which is a serious food-safety and hygiene issue.

What made it even worse was seeing the worker spread sauce inside my sandwich using her gloved hands. Even though she had gloves on, after seeing her touch her nose, this was extremely disgusting and completely ruined my appetite.

On top of all of that, my order took around 30 MINUTES to be prepared despite me being the only customer in the entire branch. There was absolutely no reason for such a long wait.

Between the flies, the poor hygiene practices, and the extremely slow service, this was one of the worst restaurant experiences I’ve had. Management seriously needs to inspect this branch and address its hygiene and food-handling standards.

textTranslated: My husband and I came from Jordan to Egypt. We were really looking for a place to eat barbecue, so my friend recommended this place, and honestly, she was incredibly helpful. The food was amazing! I was blown away by how delicious Jordanian barbecue is, but this was truly incredible. The service was excellent; we barely had to wait 10 minutes for the food to arrive. The staff were very helpful, friendly, and welcoming. One employee, Mohammed Ibrahim, was fantastic; he was always around us, making sure everything was alright. We ordered a quarter kilo of shish kebab, a quarter kilo of shish tawook, a quarter kilo of kebab, a quarter kilo of lamb chops, and something called stuffed grape leaves with trotters. We also wanted to try Egyptian molokhia. Everything was indescribable! They also recommended the desserts: knafeh and basbousa. I've literally never tasted such delicious basbousa! Everything was excellent, and I highly recommend it. However, the place was quite crowded and noisy.

name: احمد عبدالعزيز TV
text:
قمت بزيارة مطعم الدهان فرع الرحاب، وكانت تجربة جميلة لمحبي الأكل الشرقي والمشويات. المطعم من الأسماء المعروفة في مجال المطاعم المصرية، ويتميز بتقديم الأكلات التي تناسب محبي المطبخ الشرقي، كما أن وجود فرع له في الرحاب يجعله اختيارًا مناسبًا لسكان المدينة والزوار الموجودين في المنطقة.

أثناء زيارتي للمطعم استمتعت بالتعرف على المكان والأجواء المحيطة به، ويُعد المطعم من الأماكن التي يمكن التفكير فيها عند الرغبة في تناول وجبة شرقية أو الاجتماع مع الأهل والأصدقاء على الطعام. ومن الأشياء المهمة بالنسبة لي في أي مطعم الاهتمام بنظافة المكان وتنظيمه، وحسن التعامل مع الزبائن، وسهولة طلب الطعام والحصول عليه.

مطعم الدهان من المطاعم التي يرتبط اسمها بالأكلات الشرقية والمشويات، وهي من الأكلات المحببة لدى الكثير من المصريين، خصوصًا عند الرغبة في تناول وجبة مشبعة والاستمتاع بطعم الأكل المصري المعروف. كما أن وجود المطعم في منطقة الرحاب يجعله قريبًا من السكان ويسهل الوصول إليه أثناء التسوق أو قضاء الوقت في المدينة.

بشكل عام كانت زيارتي لمطعم الدهان فرع الرحاب تجربة طيبة، وأراه من الخيارات التي يمكن وضعها في الاعتبار لمحبي المطاعم الشرقية والمشويات. وأتمنى استمرار الاهتمام بجودة الطعام والنظافة وسرعة الخدمة وحسن استقبال الزبائن، لأن هذه التفاصيل هي التي تصنع تجربة جيدة وتشجع الناس على تكرار الزيارة مرة أخرى.

text:
I ordered pizza from Daje recently. Overall, it was okay- not bad, but it could definitely be improved.

The Margherita pizza was a bit disappointing. The cheese didn’t have much flavour, and the dough felt more like bread dough than proper pizza dough- quite soft and not the typical pizza texture you’d expect. I wish they had used Gouda or high-quality mozzarella instead of what seems to be local Egyptian mozzarella.

On the other hand, the mushroom pizza was very good- great taste, nicely balanced, and I’d definitely order that one again.

The waiting time was also a bit long, but I can excuse that.

Recommendation: Try improving the cheese quality- Gouda or real mozzarella would make a big difference.

name: TheHIJRAHGuy
text:
I’ve been looking for good Somali food around New Cairo, and honestly, Sahara Kitchen is a gem. As far as I know, it’s the only Somali restaurant in Rehab, and definitely one of the few in the whole New Cairo area.

The food is really tasty, the prices are reasonable, and the customer service is 10/10. Everyone was friendly and welcoming, and the food genuinely felt worth the wait. It can take a little longer to come out, but good food is worth waiting for!

There aren’t loads of vegetarian options, which is probably the only downside, and parking can be a bit difficult on weekends because the area gets busy.

But overall, I really enjoyed the experience and would definitely recommend it if you’re craving Somali food in Cairo.

If you visit, let them know the Hijrah Guy sent you! 🇸🇴🇪🇬

name: BASSAM MONTASER
text:
المطعم كبير مش صغير و نظيف جدا جدا
و فريق العمل كله محترم جدا جدا و مضياف و لذيذ
و الاكل تحفه فعلا انا جربت جمبري بطر فلاي و جمبري مقلي و مكرونه جمبري و سبيط طاجن احمر سبايسي و حتي الارز الساده كان حلو جدا
و هما نزوا ملوخيه و بذنجان و مهلبيه و حلويات شرقيه بعد الاجل كا ضيافه

بشكرهم جدا و بالاخص محمود بوجي هو الي كان مسؤال عن الترابيزه بتاعتنا
textTranslated:
The restaurant is large, not small, and very clean.

The entire staff is extremely respectful, hospitable, and delicious.
The food is truly amazing. I tried the butterfly shrimp, fried shrimp, shrimp pasta, spicy red squid casserole, and even the plain rice was delicious.

They also served molokhia, eggplant, muhallebi, and oriental sweets after our meal as a complimentary treat.

I thank them very much, especially Mahmoud Bouji, who was in charge of our table.

text:
I had such a wonderful dinner with my friends at Octoba, and honestly, it was an amazing first-time experience and definitely not my last!

Thank you for the incredible and creative dishes. Every plate was beautifully presented and full of unique flavors. A special thank you to Mr. Hatem for the amazing reconstructions and for taking such great care of our table.

Huge appreciation to the entire staff for their warm, friendly, and attentive service, and of course, a special thank you to the chef for creating such delicious dishes with thoughtfully selected ingredients. Everything tasted absolutely amazing!

What I loved the most is the beautiful fusion of modern Asian and Egyptian cuisine creative, unexpected, and absolutely delicious.

I truly loved the experience from beginning to end.
Highly recommended!

And yes… I’ll definitely be back!

The place is clean, but the space is a bit small, so there might be a waiting list.

They're originally from Port Said, by the way.

name: عبدالرحمن
text:
يقع المطعم في سوق الرحاب.
المطعم صغير وبسيط، والجلسات في الدور الأول.
لاااااكن لذاذة الطعام خرافية، والسعر معقول جدا.
جربت السنجاري، والروبيان المقلي والمشوي، وشوربة السمك، وطاجن السمك. كل طبق أفضل من الثاني دون مبالغة.

وبإمكانك بعد الطعام التجول في السوق، فهو يستحق.
textTranslated:
The restaurant is located in Al Rehab Market.

The restaurant is small and simple, with seating on the first floor.

But the food is absolutely delicious, and the prices are very reasonable.

I tried the singari, the fried and grilled shrimp, the fish soup, and the fish tagine. Every dish was better than the last, without exaggeration.

After your meal, you can stroll around the market; it's well worth it.

text:

واخدنا بيتزا كاورترو فورماجي مع الاسف كانت ماليهاش علاقة بالبيتزا الإيطالية اطلاقاً العجينة عادية جداً والجبنة طعمها مالح كأنهم حاطين جبة رومي عليها و سعرها في المنيو مكتوب 260 لكن لما استلمنا الفاتورة كاتبين تحت البيتزا ان في 60 جنيه حق الجبنة😂
يعني هي البيتزا بالأجبان الاربعة مكتوب سعرها 260 بس انت حتدفع 60 حق جبنة الله اعلم ليه😭😂

اجواء المطعم جميلة والخدمات كويسة والفيو حلو
textTranslated:
Our experience at Qubba Restaurant was that we got the Pasta Frutti di Mare, which was delicious, flavorful, and full of seafood.

We also got the Quartro Formaggi pizza, which unfortunately had absolutely nothing to do with Italian pizza. The dough was very ordinary, and the cheese tasted salty, like they'd put Turkish cheese on it. The price on the menu was listed as 260, but when we received the bill, it said there was an extra 60 pounds for the cheese! 😂 So, the four-cheese pizza is listed as 260, but you have to pay 60 pounds for cheese? I don't know why! 😭😂

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, good service, and a lovely view.
responseFromOwnerText:
شكرًا جدًا لمشاركتنا تجربتكم بكل تفاصيلها. سعداء إن الباستا وأجواء أوبا والخدمة والفيو نالوا إعجابكم، وفي نفس الوقت نعتذر إن تجربة البيتزا لم تكن بالمستوى المتوقع منكم.

ملاحظاتكم محل تقدير كبير بالنسبة لنا، وخصوصًا فيما يتعلق بالطعم وتفاصيل الفاتورة، وهنحرص على مراجعتها مع الفريق المختص. نتمنى نقدر نستقبلكم مرة تانية ونقدم لكم تجربة أفضل تليق بأوبا.

name: Bader Alsuqair
text:
تجربة رائعة من البداية للنهاية. 🐟✨

طلبنا السمك وكان طازجًا ولذيذًا جدًا، والتحضير كان ممتازًا والنكهات متوازنة. والحلى كان أكثر من رائع وختم الوجبة بطريقة جميلة. أما الشيشة فكانت ممتازة، نكهتها مميزة وخدمتها سريعة.

الأجواء مريحة وهادئة، والطاقم محترم وبشوش ومتعاون، والخدمة كانت على مستوى عالٍ. من الأماكن التي تستحق الزيارة، وبالتأكيد سأكرر التجربة وأنصح بها لكل من يبحث عن مكان يجمع بين الأكل اللذيذ والأجواء الجميلة
textTranslated:
A fantastic experience from start to finish. 🐟✨

We ordered fish, and it was fresh and incredibly delicious. The preparation was excellent, and the flavors were perfectly balanced. The dessert was more than wonderful and beautifully concluded the meal. The shisha was also excellent, with a distinctive flavor and fast service.

The atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing, the staff is respectful, cheerful, and helpful, and the service is top-notch. It's definitely worth a visit, and I will certainly repeat the experience and recommend it to anyone looking for a place that combines delicious food with a beautiful atmosphere.

text:
Without a doubt, one of the finest seafood restaurants in Egypt. The quality of the ingredients is exceptional, with a wide variety of fresh seafood options prepared to suit different tastes. The menu is diverse and thoughtfully curated, offering everything from traditional Egyptian seafood dishes to more refined culinary selections.
The cooking is consistently excellent, highlighting the freshness and natural flavors of the seafood. The service is professional, attentive, and welcoming, ensuring a pleasant dining experience from start to finish.
The restaurant also maintains high standards of cleanliness and presentation, creating a comfortable and enjoyable atmosphere. Whether you are looking for a casual seafood meal or a special dining experience, this restaurant stands out as a top destination for seafood lovers in Egypt.

text:
Worst staff ever.

الموظفين من اسوأ ما يكون مش محترفين نهائياً ولا حتى بيحترموا الزباين.
و دي مش تجربتي السيئة الاولى مع نفس الستاف بتاع المكان دا، قولت اديهم فرصة و استنى مرة و اتنين و تلاتة قبل ما اعمل الريڤيو دا.
دا غير طبعاً ان كل الاوردرات بتطلع غلط او ناقصة و تقريبا عمري ما جبت منهم اوردر غير و كان ناقص او مش مظبوت.
غير كدة الاكل تمام كويس.
بس منصحش حد يتعامل معاهم اخرك ديليڤري بس.
textTranslated:
Worst staff ever.

The staff are absolutely terrible. They're unprofessional and have no respect for customers.

And this isn't my first bad experience with the same staff at this place. I decided to give them a chance and wait a couple of times before writing this review.

Besides that, almost every order I place is either wrong or incomplete. I've practically never ordered from them without it being missing or not quite right.

Aside from that, the food is okay.

But I wouldn't recommend anyone deal with them. Your best bet is delivery.

text:
We had an outstanding experience at Sakura – Fifth Settlement! From the moment we arrived, the restaurant was clean, beautifully designed, and had a warm, relaxing atmosphere that made us feel comfortable right away.

The service was exceptional. The entire team was welcoming, attentive, and genuinely cared about making sure we had a great dining experience. We were celebrating a birthday, and they went above and beyond to make it a memorable occasion with their kindness and thoughtful gestures.

The food was absolutely amazing. The sushi was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The noodles were just as impressive—perfectly cooked, delicious.

A very special thank you to Ramy, Emam, and Khaled for their outstanding hospitality, professionalism, and friendly attitude. They made us feel truly welcome and ensured everything was perfect throughout our visit. Please also extend our appreciation to the entire Sakura team for their excellent work.

One of the best sushi experiences I’ve had! 🍣 Everything was super fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. You can really tell they pay attention to every detail.

The service was exceptional from the moment we arrived. A special thanks to our waiter, Youssef, who was always smiling, attentive, and incredibly helpful. He took the time to explain the menu, answered all our questions, and helped us choose the perfect dishes.

To top it all off, they surprised us with a complimentary mojito, and it was absolutely delicious! Such a thoughtful gesture that made our visit even more memorable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for high-quality sushi, excellent service, and a fantastic overall dining experience. Can’t wait to visit again!

text:
​If you're craving real Central Texas craft smokehouse BBQ, Longhorn Texas BBQ (O1 Mall, New Cairo & Arkan Plaza, Sheikh Zayed) delivers the real deal.
​The Brisket: Hands down the best in Cairo. Smoked low-and-slow over hardwood, it features a rich peppery bark, a deep smoke ring, and melt-in-your-mouth tenderness.
​Other Highlights: The giant Dino beef ribs are incredible, and the brisket-topped Mac & Cheese, creamed corn, and house pickles round out the meal perfectly.
​The Atmosphere: Smells like pure woodsmoke, rustic, and laid-back—stepping inside genuinely feels like being transported straight to an Austin roadhouse.
​A bit price-wise on the higher end, but completely worth it for unmatched quality.

name: Wadda
text:
No matter how many Lebanese restaurants open in Cairo, Al Beiruti at Garden8  will always be one of my favorites. We went as a party of three and ordered a proper Lebanese spread, and honestly, most of it reminded me why I keep coming back.

I’ll start with the dishes that impressed me the least.

The warak enab was good, but it needed more of a kick. I wanted more lemon, acidity, or pomegranate molasses to give the filling that extra zing 6/10

The msakhan rolls were another miss for me. I liked the charred bread on the outside, but the filling lacked flavor, and the char itself added a slightly bitter taste that overpowered everything 5/10

Now onto the good stuff 😋

The mutabbal was smoky and silky smooth, with bursts of freshness from the pomegranate seeds and a lovely tang from the pomegranate molasses. The combination of smoky sweet eggplant, acidity and crunch was just beautiful 9/10

The hummus with minced meat and pine nuts was honestly perfect. The hummus was creamy and smooth, with just the right seasoning, while the meat and pine nuts added richness, flavor and texture. It didn’t need anything else 10/10

The fattoush was decent with the acidity I like, and I loved the crunchy za’atar crackers they added. They did feel a little stale, though, which took away from the experience 7/10

The batata harra came hot and crispy, with a lovely bite. good plate to share. 7/10.

But my personal favorite savory dish was the ras asfour with mustard sauce. The meat was incredibly flavorful, coated in that delicious mustard sauce, and we honestly licked the plate clean. It came with potato wedges, which I suspect were there to soak up all that sauce, but the potatoes themselves needed more seasoning. The meat was absolutely delicious 9/10

For dessert, we tried the halawet jibn, filled with what I believe was ashta and served with simple syrup on the side. It was good, but nothing particularly memorable for me 6/10

The real star was the مفروكة الفستقThat combination of crispy, crushed kunafa, fresh ashta and crunchy pistachios, finished with simple syrup, was everything. The textures were spot on, the sweetness was perfectly balanced, and every bite was just beautiful. Easily my favorite dessert of the meal10/10

The Arabic coffee was also really good and the perfect way to finish the meal.

Service was very good throughout. The manager came by to check on us, and the bread basket was replenished regularly, which I always appreciate.

Overall, a solid 9/10 experience, it’s on the expensive side, but for me, the food, atmosphere and service make it worth it. A couple of dishes could be better, but Al Beiruti remains a favorite and I’ll definitely keep coming back.

textTranslated:
The food was absolutely delicious, but when they found out I was Saudi, they tried to scam me.
The bill was 2969, but the cashier added a zero, making it 29067. He was trying to be clever, but thankfully I didn't top up my prepaid card with more than 1000 riyals. Here's a picture to prove it.

title: Barbar By D

name: Mohammed Ismail
text:
Overall the product quality is fairly good and the team is friendly and understanding if you are ordering at restaurant. One major problem Akkawi man2ousha can not be served without mozzarella cheese, which is unlike what is served in Lebanon. The strange reason that you hear here and some other shops that it is already mixed together and it is better for the man2ousha. These are two reasons that are difficult to comprehend especially that at its home country is done plain akkawi as default, unless you request to mix cheese
The review has been edited as I faced incredibly poor service and lack of commitment from the call center team. Ordered food and came one time cold, attributed to being Talabat delivery is the reason, rather order from us directly. This is not professional at all as they are your partner. The. I followed their recommendation and put talabat aside hoping the service is better as they claimed, unfortunately it was similiar in delay and food being cold. Let alone a visa machine that the delivery person unable to operate. They offered to send another one and then when i was following up with them, they decided no we will not as based on our investigation it left the restaurant on-time and the branch paid for it. I explained I already paid and this was promised a replacement, the call center representative, that he asked branch manager and call center manager will call me. Branch manager called back and he sent a replacement for the items that were received cold. Bottom line, if you want,  eat at the restaurant; delivery orders i do not recommend as you can not rely upon sustained quality.

اليوم رحت على أذان المغرب أفطر عندهم وطلبت شاورما لأني مستعجل قالولي ما في شاورما, طلبت مشاوي قالولي بياخذ بس 20 دقيقة. قلتلهم تمام.
الأكل وصل بعد 5 دقايق بس وليس 20 دقيقة.
الأكل نزل بارد, وعلى الأغلب أعطوني أكل حدا ثاني كان بايت عندهم. ولما رحت أدفع قلت هذا الكلام للبنت اللي كانت واقفة تحاسب, وكان ردها إن الأكل جديد ولسا نازل من الشواية.!!
textTranslated:
Today I went to their restaurant around sunset to break my fast. I ordered shawarma because I was in a hurry, but they told me they didn't have any. I then ordered mixed grill, and they said it would only take 20 minutes. I said okay.

The food arrived after only 5 minutes, not 20.

The food arrived cold, and it was most likely that they gave me food that had been left over from someone else's meal. When I went to pay, I told the cashier this, and she replied that the food was fresh and had just come off the grill!

text:
The burger bun was really good — soft, fresh, and well toasted. The patty size was decent and satisfying, but unfortunately the overall flavor was quite average. There wasn’t any unique or standout taste in either the burger itself or the sauces, which made it less memorable than expected.

The loaded fries looked great, but the cheese sauce flavor was weak and didn’t add much to the dish.

On a positive note, the Philly cheesesteak tasted authentic and was the highlight of the meal. The flavors were well balanced and much more enjoyable compared to the burger. Overall, a mixed experience with room for improvement in flavor and seasoning.

The food was terrible; it wasn't fresh, wasn't seasoned, and wasn't salted. The lamb kofta was awful, the meat wasn't even clean beef. The hawawshi was below average, like it was frozen and not salted at all. The only good thing was the crispy bread. The best thing was the orzo soup. The prices are outrageous, even without tahini or salad for the price.

للأسف كانت أول وآخر تجربة مع Pizza ’88.

طلبت أوردر محدد، لكن وصلني أوردر مختلف تمامًا عن اللي طلبته. تواصلت مع خدمة العملاء أكثر من مرة لحل المشكلة، لكن لم يتم تقديم أي حل أو تعويض أو حتى متابعة جادة.

Unfortunately, this was my first and last experience with Pizza '88.

I placed a specific order, but received a completely different one. I contacted customer service multiple times to resolve the issue, but no solution, compensation, or even serious follow-up was provided.

Mistakes can happen at any restaurant, but how the customer is treated afterward makes all the difference. Unfortunately, my experience was bad due to the lack of response to my complaint, so I will not be returning, and I don't recommend it to anyone.

text:
من اسوء مطاعم السمك اللى جربتها فى حياتى انز دى كانت اول مرك اطلب منهم و هتكون اخر مرة طلبت اصلا بس جنزوفلى و سمك فيليه مقلى
الفيليه مزيت جدا و القطعة رفيعة و مهرية و مفيهوش ملح ولا ليه طعم
و الجندوفلى اصلا مش جندوفلى ده بكلاويس كان فاضى اغلبه و مقفل و اللى بيفهم فى السمك يعرف انه كده ميت و مش طازة
ده غير انه السعر غالى جدا جدا مقارنة بمطاعم احسن منه و فى نفس المكان
حقيقى من اسوء التجارب و مش هتتكرر تانى
textTranslated: This is one of the worst fish restaurants I've ever tried. This was my first and last time ordering from them. I ordered clams and fried fish fillets. The fillets were incredibly oily, thin, and mushy, with no salt or flavor. The clams weren't clams at all; they were mostly empty and sealed. Anyone who knows about fish knows they're dead and not fresh. On top of that, the prices were extremely high compared to better restaurants in the same area. It was truly one of the worst experiences, and I won't be going back.

The food was average and expensive, and they didn't deliver it specially.

responseFromOwnerText:
شكرًا لمشاركتنا تقييمك، ونعتذر بصدق عن تجربتك، خاصةً فيما يتعلق بجودة الطعام والإزعاج الذي واجهته.

نود أيضًا التوضيح أن كل طلب في Pizza N’ Creams يتم تحضيره بشكل منفصل وطازج عند استلام الطلب، وبالأخص الطلبات المخصصة مثل البيتزا الـ Half & Half، والتي تتطلب تحضيرًا وعناية إضافية لضمان تنفيذ كل جانب وفقًا للمواصفات المطلوبة.

ومع ذلك، نعتذر لك بصدق عما حدث، ونأخذ ملاحظاتك بشأن الطعام والخدمة بمنتهى الجدية. ونقدّر أن تمنحنا فرصة للاطلاع على تفاصيل طلبك والعمل على تصحيح الأمر.

برجاء التواصل معنا على الخط الساخن 15257، وسيكون فريقنا سعيدًا بالتواصل معك والعمل على تحسين تجربتك وتعويضك بالشكل المناسب.

textTranslated:
The staff are so unprofessional.

Unfortunately, it was a very bad experience, even though the food was good. We ordered pizza and pasta, but only the pasta arrived. When I asked about the pizza, instead of the employee checking the order or apologizing, he responded rudely in front of my friend, saying I hadn't ordered it. I asked for the manager, but unfortunately, he didn't apologize or try to resolve the issue. He simply spoke with the employee away from us and didn't even offer to bring the missing order. Mistakes can happen, and the whole situation could have been resolved with a simple apology and a respectful gesture. However, the poor service and management completely ruined the experience. Good food alone is not enough when customer service is like this.

The poor service and unprofessional attitude completely ruined our experience, despite the food being good. A simple apology could have resolved the issue, but neither the waiter nor the manager offered one or tried to fix the missing order.

We would really appreciate the opportunity to speak with you personally, understand exactly what happened, and make things right. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and hope you will give us the opportunity to restore your confidence in Pizza N’ Creams.

name: Karim Amr
text:
Absolutely disgraceful experience at GABY’S.

I went there, placed my order, and was then told by a staff member that they would refuse to serve me anything unless I ordered food. I was literally told that if I didn’t order food, they wouldn’t bring me anything at all.

The attitude was unbelievably rude, arrogant, and completely unprofessional. If you have a mandatory food-order policy, then make it clear to customers BEFORE they sit down — don’t wait until they order and then speak to them as if they are not welcome. Although it is not their right to determine what I should order.

I’ve been to countless restaurants and cafés, and I genuinely cannot remember being treated with this level of disrespect as a customer.

A hospitality business should understand the meaning of hospitality. Based on this experience, GABY’S clearly does not.

Terrible customer service, terrible attitude, and an experience I definitely would not repeat.

name: M A
text:
Ahmed Nada Restaurant (مطعم أحمد ندا) in the Fifth District is a good choice if you enjoy traditional Egyptian oriental food, especially grilled dishes and kebab. The food was good during my visit, and the restaurant is worth considering if you are looking for an oriental dining experience with family or friends.

One of the things I liked most was the outdoor seating area. In my opinion, the outdoor atmosphere is much nicer than the indoor seating on the first floor. Sitting outside gives you a more enjoyable dining experience and makes the place feel more comfortable and suitable for a relaxed meal, especially when the weather is pleasant.

The food itself was satisfying, particularly the oriental dishes and kebab. If you are a fan of Egyptian grilled food, this is one of the main reasons to give the restaurant a try.

However, I have one suggestion for improvement regarding the music. I think the choice of songs could be better suited to the restaurant's atmosphere. Changing the playlist to something more appropriate for an oriental restaurant would make the overall experience more enjoyable and create a better ambiance for customers.
Overall, Ahmed Nada is a good option in the Fifth District for oriental food and kebab. I would personally recommend choosing the outdoor seating rather than the indoor area on the first floor for a better atmosphere. With some improvement to the music selection, the dining experience could be even better.
